llm.summary: This is mostly a project-planning skill, but it is flagged for review because it tells the agent to automatically continue into an execution skill without asking first.

dimensions.detail: The planning templates and the `docs/implementation-plan.md` output fit the stated purpose, but the skill also requires invoking `Skill(attune:project-execution)` after planning, which expands from planning into action-taking.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifact explicitly says the continuation is required and says not to prompt the user for confirmation; the `--standalone` and explicit-stop bypasses help, but the default behavior still crosses a consent boundary.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only `SKILL.md`; no executable scripts, dependencies, binaries, or install hooks were found. It references a related external Claude Code plugin and other skills that were not part of this artifact review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Saving an implementation plan file is proportionate for this purpose, but automatic transition into execution could lead to workspace modifications beyond document generation without a fresh user-controlled checkpoint.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, privilege escalation, credential handling, or network behavior appears in the artifact; the concern is workflow escalation rather than hidden runtime persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a planning workflow that may save `docs/implementation-plan.md` and then continue into an execution phase by default. To use it more safely, tell the agent to stop after planning or use the documented `--standalone` bypass before invoking it.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: the artifact-backed auto-handoff from planning to `attune:project-execution` is broader than the planning purpose.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: automatic execution is not necessary to produce an implementation plan and creates a least-surprise issue.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted for the auto-execution concern: the skill displays a checkpoint message but explicitly avoids confirmation before continuing.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Accepted: directive language requiring auto-invocation and forbidding prompts reduces user control at a high-impact transition.
